title: Secret Lair Drop Series: Back to School Superdrop

paragraphs.text: Back to School is a superdrop in the Secret Lair product range and a continuation of the alternate art Secret Lair Drop Series . It became available for purchase from the Wizards of the Coast webshop secretlair.wizards.com on April 27, 2026.
At the end of July 2025, several Secret Lairs were handed out at GCX (Gaming Community Expo) 2025 during a precon event. The Eyes Have It drop was among them.

Eight months later, a teaser for the highschool themed Superdrop connected to the release of Secrets of Strixhaven featured doodles that represented the cards from The Eyes Have It . It also featured doodles representing the indie construction and management simulation video game Dwarf Fortress created by Bay 12 Games.
The Dwarf Fortress collab was confirmed when the superdrop was officially announced. It also featured two drops that are a return to the Hasbro -owned My Little Pony franchise.

As an extra, the drops come with a surprise bonus card. For some drops, the exact card issued is random and could include retro frame Zombies (e.g. Neheb, Dreadhorde Champion ) or retro frame humans (e.g. Fiend Hunter ). Additionally, there is an extremely low chance that one could instead receive an actual metal printing plate used to print one of the cards from this Superdrop.
